mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, role, totp_secret, totp_enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, role, totp_secret, totp_enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(#{username})
SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, role, totp_secret, totp_enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT capture_pattern FROM user_capture_access WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY capture_pattern ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET failed_attempts = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE failed_attempts + 1 END, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= #{now}) AND (locked_until IS NOT NULL OR failed_attempts < #{maxFailedAttempts})
